payload.recommendation: Unchanged: retain general joint LP, scalar graph special case and fixed-prediction estimator. Adopt exclusive serial-attainment clarification. Equal-column aggregation is optional preprocessing, not necessary main-paper notation.
payload.confirmed_statement: For every feasible cell vector, consecutive within-cell exclusive stream blocks and idle remainder preserve every cell integral and finite collection of cell-linear targets. At most K(S+1) pieces and K(S+1)-1 internal switches per person suffice. This constructs a representative history; it does not preserve the actual pointwise history or impose an arbitrary external session budget.
hypothesis_limits: No minimum session duration, switching costs, nonpreemption, precedence, synchronisation or resumption delay is added.
Arbitrary within-cell target weights or instantaneous sample observations are not automatically preserved.
Cell totals may remain fractional; original observation matrix need not be TU.
Aggregation is target-specific and must retain all extra individual constraints.

confidence_projection_review.statement: If fixed x* belongs to deterministic P0 and Pr(Ax* in C_s)>=1-alpha, then Pr(h(x*) in h(P0 intersect {x:Ax in C_s}))>=1-alpha. Also Pr(P_s empty)<=alpha.
confidence_projection_review.proof: On the observation-coverage event, the true x* is feasible in P_s; its target is therefore in the projection.
confidence_projection_review.conditions: Coverage must be simultaneous, structural P0 must be correct, and closed polyhedral C_s gives attained extrema whenever nonempty P0 is compact. Empty sample-based set is a statistical flag, not an exact-data logical contradiction.

verified_counterexamples.implication: Smaller unweighted prediction SSE need not reduce design variance.
H_min=0 alone does not imply unbounded ratio.
Exclusive attention does not imply one uninterrupted task session.

payload.status: Written review and exact finite arithmetic only; no formal or empirical acceptance. No new source claims.
